programme.title: Mañana
programme.desc: Broadcast on 1 February 1956, composer Arthur Benjamin's Mañana was the first opera commissioned by the BBC.

programme.title: Sound Waves: The Symphony of Physics
programme.desc: Helen begins by exploring the simplest of ideas: what is a sound? At the Palace of Westminster, Helen teams up with scientists from the University of Leicester to investigate how Big Ben's distinctive sound is created.

programme.title: Come Dancing
programme.desc: Terry Wogan hosts as Midlands and West take on North West in the 1978 Come Dancing grand final from the Lyceum Ballroom, London. With commentary by Barri Haynes.

programme.title: Wogan: The Best Of
programme.desc: This episode features some of Britain's finest acting talents, with a cast that includes Judi Dench, Helen Mirren, Julie Walters, Bob Hoskins, Pierce Brosnan, Christopher Lee and Kenneth Branagh. There's also music from Sting and Kate Bush.

programme.title: Art of Persia

programme.title: Call My Bluff
programme.desc: Robert Robinson hosts the panel game of word definitions and deceptions. Team captains Frank Muir and Patrick Campbell are joined by Joanna Lumley, Miles Kington, Rula Lenska and Ian Wooldridge.

programme.title: Face the Music
programme.desc: Joseph Cooper invites viewers to match their musical wits against guests Joyce Grenfell, Richard Baker and Robin Ray. With guest musician Lina Lalandi.

programme.title: Brian Cox: Seven Days on Mars
programme.desc: Professor Brian Cox fulfils a childhood dream by going behind the scenes at Nasa's Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL), mission control for Mars 2020 - one of the most ambitious missions ever launched that may finally reveal if life ever existed on the red planet. In 1980, a young Brian Cox wrote to JPL asking for photos from some of their missions to the planets. The pictures they sent him from Voyager and the Viking mission to Mars were a source of inspiration.

programme.title: The Longest Goodbye
programme.desc: NASA intends to send astronauts to Mars. To succeed, crew members will have to overcome unprecedented, life-threatening challenges, and while many of these hazards are physical, the most elusive are psychological. Throughout the expected three-year absence, crew members won't be able to communicate with Earth in real time due to the immense distance.

programme.title: Meet the Ancestors
programme.sub-title: At the Sign of the Eagle
programme.desc: Archaeologist Julian Richards joins an excavation team as they uncover a rare find from a fourth-century Roman cemetery: a lead coffin, only the second ever to be found in the Roman Winchester. Unexpected clues found inside the coffin bring to light the pagan believes of a wealthy Roman buried in a Christian cemetery.

programme.title: Yes, Prime Minister
programme.desc: Jim is the guest of honour at the British Theatre Awards, but the Arts Council grant is going to be cut. While Jim is eager to avoid bad publicity, National Theatre board member Sir Humphrey wants to avoid cuts.

programme.title: Yes, Prime Minister
programme.desc: Jim Hacker decides to abolish the Department of Education and Science to reduce bureaucracy and save money, giving cash directly to schools. Sir Humphrey, of course, is appalled.

programme.title: A Timewatch Guide
programme.desc: Vanessa Collingridge examines the life of Elizabeth Tudor, with particular interest in how documentary television has examined her legacy and interrogated her reign. Using `Timewatch' and other BBC archive material stretching back over 60 years, Vanessa looks at her upbringing, her conflicts with her enemies including Mary, Queen of Scots, and her greatest victory against the Spanish Armada.

programme.title: Storyville
programme.desc: The world could not keep its eyes off two athletes at the 1994 Winter Games: Nancy Kerrigan and Tonya Harding. Just weeks before the Olympics in 1994, at the US Figure Skating Championships, Kerrigan was injured by an unknown assailant.

programme.title: The Great American Buffalo
programme.desc: By the late 1880s, the buffalo have been reduced to fewer than 1,000, and teeter on the brink of extinction. But a diverse and unlikely collection of Americans have started a few private herds in different locations, and for different reasons.

programme.title: Brian Cox's Adventures in Space and Time
programme.desc: With scientists sending space probes to the furthest reaches of the solar system and beyond, the scientific search for alien life has begun. Inspired by a childhood love of science fiction, Brian still hopes to hear from ET. He explains why this search deserves to be taken seriously, and he explores the chances of it happening.

programme.title: Tribe
programme.desc: In the frozen tundra of Northern Siberia live the Nenet reindeer herders. Explorer Bruce Parry spends a month with a Nenet brigade as they carry out their winter migration, travelling hundreds of miles as temperatures drop to minus 40 degrees.

Teleshopping
programme.desc: Presenting the latest products live on television that can be ordered directly. The product range extends from vacuum cleaners and bath towels to sports equipment.

programme.title: Channel Off Air
programme.desc: Bringing the best in television.

programme.title: Olobobs
programme.desc: Mae'r Olobobs wedi mynd am dro yn y goedwig ac yn dod o hyd i Ffosibob coll. Sut gall yr Olobobs ei helpu i ffeindio'i ffordd adre? The Olobobs are enjoying a nice walk in the forest when they bump into a poor little Fozzybob who seems to be a bit lost. Can Eye-Spy help Fozzybob find her way home? Only if he can actually find her!

programme.title: Sam Tân
programme.desc: A fireman named Sam always saves the day in the fictional Welsh rural village of Pontypandy. Alongside his fellow firefighters, he deals with all types of emergencies, from everyday problems to big disasters.

programme.title: Jen A Jim Pob Dim
programme.desc: The farm is quiet today: someone must be missing! Can the `llyfr pob dim' help Jen and Jim find the missing animal?

programme.title: Chwedlau Tinga Tinga
programme.sub-title: Pam Fod Meerkat Wastad Yn Cadw Golwg Ar Bawb?
programme.desc: There was a time when Meerkat was not always on the lookout. Meerkat used to race around Tinga Tinga bumping into things and causing chaos. She never stayed still long enough to listen to any beast.

programme.title: Byd Tad-cu
programme.desc: Pam bod mwncïod yn byw mewn coed'? yw cwestiwn Jamal i Tad-cu heddiw. Jamal asks why monkeys live in trees. Tad-cu has an absurd story, full o fun about two cheeky monkeys named Jess and Caleb.

programme.title: Cywion Bach
programme.desc: Mae gair gwych heddiw. Dere i ddysgu ac arwyddo'r gair Siwmper gyda Bip Bip, Pi Po, Bop a Bw! What a great word today. Come to learn and sign the word Siwmper (Jumper).

programme.title: Pablo
programme.desc: Nid yw Pablo'n hoffi camera newydd nain. Mae'n rhaid i Draff esbonio i'r camera sut i beidio dallu pawb cyn fod Pablo yn hapus i gael tynnu ei lun. Pablo doesn't like grandma's camera. Draff has to explain to the camera how not to blind everyone.

programme.title: Misho
programme.desc: Teimlad o bryder sydd dan sylw heddiw, ac mae Mr Diarth yn ei gwneud hi'n anodd i blentyn bach aros yn nhy Mamgu. Mr Diarth makes it difficult for a small child to stay over at Grandmas.

programme.title: Guto Gwningen
programme.desc: Mae Guto Gwningen a'i ffrindiau'n trio darganfod beth yw dyfais newydd tad Benja, Mr Sponcen. Guto Gwningen and his friends try to find out what Benja's dad's invention is used for.

programme.title: Parc Glan Gwil
programme.desc: Mae hi'n benblwydd ar Sioned Siop a sdim bwriad dathlu ganddi, ond ma Dion Diogelwch yn trefnu parti syrpreis iddi! Sioned has no intention of celebrating her birthday but others have plans.

programme.title: Anifeiliaid Bach y Byd
programme.desc: Dewch ar antur gyda ni i gwrdd ag anifeiliaid bach y byd. Y tro hwn yr Eliffant Asiaidd a'r Macac sy'n cael y sylw. This time we get to know the Asian Elephant and the Macaque.

programme.title: Stiw
programme.desc: After watching a news report about an escaped elephant Stiw sets out to trap the animal.

programme.title: Caru Canu a Stori
programme.desc: Mae Alun Asyn yn teimlo'n unig. Hoffai chwarae gyda'i ffrindiau newydd, ond does neb yn deall ei iaith hi-ho. Alun Asyn feels lonely. He would like to play with his new friends, but nobody understands his hi-ho language.

programme.title: Sion Y Chef
programme.desc: Sion takes Izzy into the countryside so that she can spot all the animals in her nature watch homework while he seeks out more fresh blackberries for his smoothies.

programme.title: Ne-wff-ion
programme.desc: Newyddion i blant hyd at 6 oed a fydd yn diddannu ac yn eu dysgu am y byd o'u cwmpas nhw yn ei holl amrywiaeth. Entertaining and educational news for children up to 6 years old.

programme.title: Og y Draenog Hapus
programme.desc: Mae Og yn poeni'n arw pan mae'n colli pigyn... Og feels very worried when he loses a spike.

programme.title: Twm Twrch
programme.desc: Mae heddiw'n ddiwrnod Cystadleuaeth Sglefrio yng Nghwmtwrch a mae pawb yn ymuno yn yr hwyl hyd yn oed Twm Twrch! Today is the day of the Skating Competition in Cwmtwrch and everyone is joining in the fun.

programme.title: Ein Byd Bach Ni
programme.desc: Dewch ar daith o gwmpas y byd! Heddiw: ymweliad â chyfandir Asia a gwlad Siapan. Yma, byddwn ni'n dysgu am fwyd Siapaneaidd fel swshi ac yn ymweld â'r brifddinas sef Tokyo. A visit to the continent of Asia and the country of Japan.

programme.title: Joni Jet
programme.desc: Mae Joni'n credu bod Capsiwl Dyffryn Dryswch yn llawn trysor. Ond mae'r dihirod yn hefyd, ac yn benderfynol o'i ddwyn! Joni's convinced that the Dyffryn Dryswch Capsule is full of treasure!

programme.title: Cacamwnci
programme.desc: Cyfres gomedi i blant meithrin sy'n cynnwys sgetsys, eitemau doniol, jôcs a chymeriadau dwl iawn. A comedy show for pre-school children, full of sketches, jokes, fun, monkey nonsense and great new comedy characters.

programme.title: Olobobs
programme.desc: Mae'r Olobobs yn clywed cân snwff swynol - ond bob tro mae'r Olobobs yn ceisio closio at y Snwff Arbennig mae'n hedfan i ffwrdd. A all Bari Barfog eu helpu i ddysgu mwy am y creadur dirgel hwn?The Olobobs hear a beautiful snoof song but find it impossible to get near the special snoof - every time they approach it the snoof flies away. Can Twitchybeard help them learn more about this mysterious creature?

programme.title: Sam Tân
programme.desc: Mae Pontypandy yn llawn cyffro pan ddaw tywysog brenhinol i ymweld. Pontypandy is abuzz with excitement when a royal prince comes to visit.

programme.title: Jen A Jim Pob Dim

programme.title: Chwedlau Tinga Tinga
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Cricket didn't chirrup. In fact Cricket didn't do anything at all and it was beginning to get him down. Every animal has a use - Elephant trumpets, Lion roars, but what does Cricket do?

programme.title: Byd Tad-cu
